source: GitHub accessible repository inventory for owner thebrazenbeard

inventory_digests.algorithm: SHA-256 over lexicographically sorted repository names, UTF-8, one name per line with trailing newline

privacy_rule: Private repository names and private technical detail are intentionally not published by this public repository. Private repositories still participate in the analysis and aggregate counts.

role_semantics.direct_architecture_subjects: Repositories containing potentially reusable mechanics, overlapping infrastructure, implementation duplication, orchestration, evidence, currentness, recovery, transport, cognition, or experiment machinery.
role_semantics.boundary_or_negative_control_consumers: Repositories useful for proving that a proposed substrate preserves domain-specific semantics and independence rather than swallowing them.
role_semantics.historical_or_reference_only: Repositories retained for provenance/comparison and not presumed to be current architecture candidates.
role_semantics.discovery_self: Discovery must also be reviewed for overreach and accidental framework gravity.
role_semantics.unclassified_since_prior_cut: Repositories beyond the previously classified set remain explicitly unclassified in the census until dedicated exact-head review; separate classification artifacts do not change census authority.

completeness_rule: A repository does not need to be a consolidation candidate to be included. Exclusion from a particular experiment must be explicit rather than inferred from absence.
refresh_rule: Any change in repository count, visibility split, public repository set, repository identity/path binding, or any inventory digest invalidates claims that this exact census is current. The current inventory binds 77 accessible repositories; semantic role changes require separate classification evidence.

source_validated: public repository count equals public_repositories length
public_names_sha256 recomputes from lexicographically sorted public_repositories
census observed_date is joined to graph/intake current cut

privacy_validation_ceiling: Public repository membership/digest and aggregate counts are source-validated. Private/all-name digests are externally supplied commitments in this public repository and are not independently recomputable here.
